blocks.html:
This workflow cancels an order's fulfillment. It's used by the [Cancel Order's Fulfillment Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#orders\_postordersidfulfillmentsfulfillment\_idcancel).

This workflow has a hook that allows you to perform custom actions on the canceled fulfillment. For example, you can pass under `additional_data` custom data that
allows you to update custom data models linked to the fulfillment.

You can also use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to wrap custom logic around canceling a fulfillment.

steps.name: cancelOrderFulfillmentValidateOrder
steps.description:
This step validates that an order fulfillment can be canceled. If
the fulfillment doesn't exist, or it has already been shipped, the step throws an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order and fulfillment details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

steps.name: adjustInventoryLevelsStep
steps.description:
This step adjusts the stocked quantity of one or more inventory levels. You can
pass a positive value in `adjustment` to add to the stocked quantity, or a negative value to
subtract from the stocked quantity.

steps.name: cancelOrderFulfillmentStep
steps.description: This step cancels an order's fulfillment.

steps.name: createReservationsStep
steps.description: This step creates one or more reservations.

steps.name: updateReservationsStep
steps.description: This step updates one or more reservations.

steps.name: emitEventStep
steps.description:
This step emits an event, which you can listen to in a [subscriber](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/events-and-subscribers). You can pass data to the
subscriber by including it in the `data` property.

The event is only emitted after the workflow has finished successfully. So, even if it's executed in the middle of the workflow, it won't actually emit the event until the workflow has completed successfully. 
If the workflow fails, it won't emit the event at all.

steps.name: orderFulfillmentCanceled
steps.description: This hook is executed after the fulfillment is canceled. You can consume this hook to perform custom actions on the canceled fulfillment.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order to cancel its fulfillment.

children.name: fulfillment_id
children.description: The ID of the fulfillment to cancel.

children.name: no_notification
children.description: Whether to notify the customer about the cancellation.

children.name: canceled_by
children.description: The ID of the user that canceled the fulfillment.

children.name: additional_data
children.description:
Additional data that can be passed through the `additional_data` property in HTTP requests.

Learn more in [this documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).

Hooks allow you to inject custom functionalities into the workflow. You'll receive data from the workflow, as well as additional data sent through an HTTP request.

Learn more about [Hooks](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/workflow-hooks) and [Additional Data](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/api-routes/additional-data).
This hook is executed after the fulfillment is canceled. You can consume this hook to perform custom actions on the canceled fulfillment.
Handlers consuming this hook accept the following input.

types.name: input
types.description: The input data for the hook.
